text:
kevin: opening a follow-up for the 'memory drip' observed on prod-kv (hot pool) ~08:12 UTC. no hard OOMs yet but slow resident growth over ~6h. posting actions here.
sasha: saw it too. APM traces show increased allocation rate on msgpack encoding paths when seq_len > 800.
lee: uploaded two heap snapshots + allocation timeline: gs://redwood/prof/2474000123/snapshots.tgz. early diff points to tlsBuffer and slice headers retained in IndexEntry.
mina: tagging infra because we might try madvise(DONTNEED) on freed spans as an experiment. platform implications?
ops-bot: deploy started "canary/pool-reuse-v2" at 2474000200 1 shard canary.
kevin: proposed owners & quick plan: 1) deep profiling + flamegraphs -> @lee -> target Mon EOD; 2) pool & zero-copy patch -> @sasha -> PR by tomorrow AM; 3) madvise purge canary -> @mina -> metrics by Wed; 4) soft-residency guard design -> @kevin -> spec by Thu.
sasha: pooling approach: migrate msgpack encoder buffers to per-shard sync.Pool with strict release in defer. microbench locally shows 45% lower alloc churn.
lee: flamegraph link: gs://redwood/prof/2474000123/flame.svg. alloc stacks point to encoder.encode -> index.go:142 -> persist.commit. also seeing elevated fragmentation ratio in jemalloc stats.
mina: madvise approach low-risk on canary VMs: call madvise(DONTNEED) after large free bursts to return pages to OS. will instrument page-fault counters and RSS.
kevin: soft-residency guard: make it per-shard, percentile-triggered (p95 seq_len) and additive margin over 30d baseline. ramp: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. rollback if tail latency or OOMs spike.
lee: small code snippet showing retention site:
```
func (e *IndexEntry) Attach(b []byte) {
  e.buf = append(e.buf[:0], b...) // keeps backing arrays alive
}
```
sasha: fix is to copy into pool-provided buffer or use zero-copy view slice that doesn't extend original backing memory. will include tests.
ops-bot: Jira RI-2901 created for pool/zero-copy, assigned to sasha, due 2027-04-08.
mina: will run madvise canary tomorrow night (quiet window) and post graphs. linking perf repro: https://perf.redwood/repro/msgpack-longseq-2027.
kevin: added tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/memory-drip-track. filled owners + tentative dates.
lee: note: if pooling reduces alloc rate but resident set persists, we may need compact cadence + targeted eviction of sequences older than X. add as contingency.
sasha: opened branch feat/pool-zero-copy-2901. bench notes in PR. will add migration checklist for shard handoffs.
kevin: weekly sync Fri 09:00 PT to close actions and verify no regression. I'll update postmortem with owners, tickets, and sheet link. cc @lee @sasha @mina
deploy-bot: canary "canary/pool-reuse-v2" reported metrics: resident_delta -3.2% on shard canary at 2474000400.
mina: early madvise probe shows slight RSS drop but transient page faults increased; will tune pacing.
kevin: thanks team. short-term goal: eliminate drift signal within 72h or enable short eviction ramp. long-term: reduce fragmentation + harden alloc paths.
